name: Skeletal
function: Show the skeletal framework that supports the trunk and links it to the limbs.
overview: BodyParts3D skeleton and translucent envelope share the source frame.
detail: Compare the right knee in its source pose and at 20° more flexion. The femur stays fixed, the tibia and fibula rotate together, and arrows indicate qualitative load directions.
limit: The tibial plateau clears the femur in both sampled poses. The hinge omits rolling, gliding and soft-tissue loading. The skeleton’s 271 representation meshes include bone, cartilage/disc and dental categories.

name: Respiratory

detail: Follow air from the nasal cavity through the pharynx and larynx, along the trachea to a left lobar branch and an enlarged alveolar cluster. Open the gas-exchange stage from the terminal focus.

name: Digestive
function: Trace food from intake through the gut, with accessory organs placed relative to their delivery points.
